scene.ko: 동료가 집들이에 초대하자, 조금 늦을 수 있다고 미리 말하고 가져갈 것과 주소를 묻는다.

lines.en: Hey, we're having a housewarming party next Friday. Would you like to come?
lines.ko: 저희 다음 주 금요일에 집들이하는데, 오실래요?

lines.en: Oh, congratulations on the new place! I'd love to. What time?
lines.ko: 와, 이사 축하해요! 좋아요. 몇 시예요?
alt: Congrats on your new place! I'd be happy to come. What time does it start?

lines.en: Around seven. It's pretty casual, just some food and games.
lines.ko: 7시쯤이요. 그냥 편한 자리예요. 음식 먹고 게임하고요.

lines.en: Sounds fun. I have a class until seven, though, so I might be a little late. Is that okay?
lines.ko: 재밌겠네요. 그런데 7시까지 수업이 있어서 조금 늦을 수도 있어요. 괜찮아요?
alt: That sounds great. But I have a class until seven, so I may be a bit late. Is that all right?

lines.en: No problem at all. Come whenever you can.
Thanks. Can I bring anything? Maybe some drinks or dessert?
lines.ko: 고마워요. 뭐 가져갈까요? 음료나 디저트 같은 거요?
alt: Great. Should I bring something, like drinks or dessert?

lines.en: Dessert would be great. My wife loves anything chocolate.
lines.ko: 디저트면 좋죠. 아내가 초콜릿 들어간 건 다 좋아하거든요.

lines.en: Perfect. Could you text me your new address?
lines.ko: 좋아요. 새 주소 문자로 보내 줄 수 있어요?
alt: Got it. Can you send me the address?
Great. Please text me the address.

expressions.note: on + 축하할 일 · 줄여서 Congrats on ___!

expressions.en: I might be a little late.
